$comment: W48 G0 (b): the corrected protocol (charter 2026-10-06-w48-dark-operators-fit.md, Decision Log 3, X71-X73),
hashed in part 1 BEFORE any verdict exists. No ladder is rendered: the rungs are W47's, read from W47's
committed readings by key (X71; ladders/evidence.json pins them and the archive they replay from). The
verdicts are ladders/verdicts.py's reading of W47's reread.json (ladders (i), (iii), (iv)) and results.json
(ladder (ii), not re-read) under the bars below, written to ladders/verdicts.json after part 1's hash (clause 3).
Units: B = max(1 code, 2 bar) per cell (bar 0.5 code on every dark cell); a cell's change band and away band
are cuts/rule.py `reads()`'s, as W47's re-read recorded them; R is the share of a fine cell's T1-fine excess
E = fine(reference) - fine(native) a rung removes.

rungs.what: the rungs, their overrides and cells are W47's protocol's; no rung is added, removed or rendered

perScale: no thick cell whose away band reads `away` with growth > awayCeilingB x B
at most awayBeyondBMax of the five whose away band reads `away` with growth > B
no thick cell over Apple at the reference on its change band (reference > native) reads `away`: `toward` and `unchanged` are both admitted, the rule's own states
the thin rest cells keep at least half of point A's gain (W47 ladder (i)'s thin clause, unchanged: reread.json thinKeepsHalf)
L1 passes on its population (W47's level reading, unchanged: reread.json L1passes)
operator 1.reads: reread.json rungs[label].perScale[scale]: thick[cell].changeBand and .awayBand {n, c, k, B, growth, change}, thinGain, pointAThinGain, thinKeepsHalf, L1passes

perScale: each fine cell: E = fine(reference) - fine(native) > 0 and R = (fine(reference) - fine(rung)) / E >= fineExcessRemovedMin on T1-fine
each guard: whole-band T1 (k - c) / B >= -guardFloorB
beside, deciding nothing: each fine cell's whole-band fall -g / B, carried to the gate
operator 2.reads: reread.json rungs[label].perScale[scale]: fine.cells[cell] {native, reference, rung, E, R, wholeFallInB}, guards.deltaInB

joint.reading: operator 1's partition (a) over the four readings (the two fine cells at 1x and 2x) on their change and away bands, and operator 2's halving (b) on each; the photo inactive ratio against point A's is reported and decides nothing; ladder (iv) decides only name-target

2x width.reading: not re-stated and not re-read (W47 Decision Log 8; W48 Decision Log 4): results.json operators['2x width'] stands; the second tap is not a stage-1 member and no 1x gap is named

separation.operator 1: separates when a ladder (i) rung meets bar (a) at BOTH scales
separation.operator 2: the tap separates when a ladder (iii) tap rung (sizeFineTapSigma / sizeFineTapShare) meets bar (b) at BOTH scales; the receded body width meets when a ladder (iii) optics.regular.blurSigma rung does; when both meet, both are stage-2 members and the gate reads both (Decision Log 3 (c); no precedence)
separation.oneScale: a rung meeting at one scale only is recorded and is not a fit start (Decision Log 3 (f)); the ones the parent ruled off the grid are `offGrid`; any OTHER rung meeting at one scale only stops part 2 for the parent (W47's one-scale rule stands for the fit)

offGrid.note: Decision Log 3 (f) and Decision Log 4, ruled before any W48 verdict from W47's re-read as the charter quotes it; part 2's grids carry none of these values

decisions.fit: an operator whose bar is met at BOTH scales by some rung (verdicts.json) is fitted on the draft's grids; when the tap and the body width both meet, both are fitted (no precedence)
decisions.name-unfitted: an operator with no rung meeting its bar at both scales is NOT fitted: part 2 names it with its reading (X63) and none of its leaves stays
decisions.name-target: a target no lever moves is named, not fitted (X63): recorded in notFitted with its ladder and the operator's shape, every draft leaf carrying it removed
decisions.narrow: replace a declared grid by a non-empty subset of itself inside the lever's non-flat range (the active tintAlpha: the snapshot's value and the ladder (i) base rungs at which L1 passes)
decisions.strike: remove a family leaf whose rungs read flat (no cell beyond its bar), or the receded body width when no body-width rung meets bar (b) at both scales
decisions.hold: fix a non-operator leaf at a named value without a flat rung: the leaf leaves the search and joins its family's `fixed` at that value; only a leaf the draft marks `holdable` with that value, only on a parent's ruling named by its charter Decision Log (Decision Log 3 (d))
decisions.stop: if neither operator separates, the wave closes at G0 with the finding and part 2 is not hashed

removed.name-1x-gap: ladder (ii) met no rung and is not re-read; its leaves are not in the draft (Decision Log 4)

expected.what: the charter's predictions (clause 3's Bar), hashed here BEFORE the verdicts; verdicts.py reports each against the reading and a difference is said, never absorbed

joint.note: misses the photo floor by 0.02 / 0.01 bar (recorded; the joint decides only name-target)

rulings.decision-log-3-a: operator 1's separating bar is the landing rule's partition on the five thick rest cells against Apple, with `unchanged` admitted on the over-Apple cells (closes W47 Decision Log 8's "toward" clause, which failed a rung inside the budget on `hc-text-7` at −0.30 / 0.00 B);
rulings.decision-log-3-b: operator 2 is read on T1-fine, R ≥ 0.5 per cell and scale, the whole band reported beside it (closes the whole-band bar);
rulings.decision-log-3-c: when the receded body width and the tap both meet (b), both are stage-2 members and the gate reads both; there is no precedence decision kind (closes body-width-first, which named the stronger lever unfitted);
rulings.decision-log-3-d: `hold` joins the decision kinds: a non-operator leaf may be held at a named value without flat rungs (closes `strike` as the only removal); the parent may hold `sizeOcclusionGain` at 0.05 and the span tops at part 2 if the ladders' gain reading argues it;
rulings.decision-log-3-e: `check-fit` validates part 2 against `verdicts.json`, the Decision Log 3 reading (closes the check that read the original bars' `results.json`);
rulings.decision-log-3-f: the σ 2 and share 0.5 rungs, which met at one scale only, are off the grid: a lever that meets at one scale is not a fit start (ruled now; W47's one-scale rule stands for the fit);
rulings.decision-log-3-g: `amend` and `amend-fit` refuse an empty ops list (closes the empty-ops defect).
